text:
Marta: Quick heads-up — kicking off an entitlement sweep next week focused on admin/stale access and least-privilege for infra, platform, and KMS keys. Goal: discovery -> approvals -> canary removals -> full cleanup within 2 weeks. Draft checklist: discovery, owner confirm, justification, canary removal, rollback playbook. Doc: https://redwood.internal/ops/sec/entitlement-sweep (WIP)

Devin: I can own the infra services roster (compute, gke, load-balancer service accounts). Will pull from infra-config and cloud IAM exports.

Alex: I’ll take KMS key access mapping. Need a list of CMKs + current bindings. Helpful tip: run `gcloud kms keys list --location=global --project=redwood-prod --format=json` then `gcloud iam policies get-iam-policy KEY_RESOURCE` for bindings.

Sam: Also plan to run audit log queries to find who used SetIamPolicy / CryptoKeyEncrypt / CryptoKeyDecrypt in the last 90 days. Example query for logs UI: `protoPayload.methodName="SetIamPolicy" resource.type="kms_crypto_key" timestamp>="2025-01-01T00:00:00Z"`

Marta: Nice. Timeline proposal: week 1 = discovery + owner outreach; week 2 = approvals + canary removals (one staging svc then prod). Ticket: RDW-SEC-ENT-2025-01 (will create). Canary rollback plan must be documented with exact steps and contacts.

Devin: Question: for dedicated monitoring accounts that currently have cross-project admin, should we convert to viewer+specific roles (monitoring.metricWriter, logging.logWriter) instead of blanket admin? That reduces blast radius.

Alex: +1. Also we should enforce that human users are not in CMK bindings — only service principals. Add an automated check: flag any binding where `member` matches `user:`.

Sam: Will put together the log detection queries and a daily report. Also recommend we run a quick vuln triage for any infra principals that have both admin and an active SSH/key access recently — correlate last-login + admin grants.

Priya: I’ll coordinate with product/platform teams to confirm owners and valid business justifications for any admin role. I’ll also book 30m sync with each team if needed.

sec-bot: Previous entitlement review ran 2024-11-12 and flagged 32 admin principals with no recent justification. See auto-report: https://redwood.internal/sec/reports/last-entitlement-review-20241112

Marta: Assignments: Devin = infra roster + canary list; Alex = KMS mapping + IAM queries + exception list; Sam = audit-log queries + detection rules + daily report; Priya = owner confirmations and justifications. I’ll own overall coordination and ticket updates.

Devin: Will start exporting IAM bindings today and share a short CSV in the ticket.

Alex: I’ll run the KMS scans and post a mapping table of key -> bindings -> suggested owner. Will include a script snippet for reviewers.

Sam: After we remove/modify roles, we should monitor error rates and alerts for 48h. If any service breaks, we revert via the ticket and rollback playbook.

Marta: Agreed. Final note: be conservative with removals in week 2 — prefer to remove one permission at a time where feasible. Add discrete PRs for each change so we have audit trail. :thumbsup:

Priya: Thanks — will start outreach tomorrow and update ticket with responses.

Marta: Great. If anyone finds high-risk keys or cross-project admins, ping me and @oncall immediately. End of thread for kickoff — follow-ups will be in the ticket and weekly sync.
